description: This file defines a PHP trait 'HTMLUtils' that provides utility methods related to HTML formatting, including directory management and theme copying.

methods.name: ensureEmptyDestination
methods.description: Ensures that the destination directory is empty by removing it if it exists or creating it otherwise.

methods.name: copyThemes
methods.description: Copies the theme files from the local base directory to the destination directory, creating a 'themes' subdirectory.
